ownerDirective: Audit all text and remove direct player-facing puzzle solution instructions, retain environmental clues and unchanged game mechanics
styleRules: Player descriptions show sensory detail, physical affordances, atmospheric observations and consequences, never solution commands.
Do not name the exact required puzzle item, item origin, character, order, combination, roll DC, or explicit success threshold before discovery.
Mechanical permission/provenance/safety/reward checks remain in code and GM-only prompts; only player-visible messages change.
Interaction controls may retain concise functional labels but must not identify the puzzle-solving item or answer.
Never silently regenerate old ChatMessages, GM-only documentation, archived source snapshots, or DnD item rule mechanics.
After every text patch, verify exact live source old/new, original event/disabled/flags, test full source and preserve a chronological handoff.

auditNotes: Only live text sources and modules were edited. Archived original source snapshots remain unchanged for provenance.
The 331 journal page records include blank/image/title-only records; no puzzle instruction detected in available page text by targeted search.
Historical ChatMessages are preserved as chronological record; no targeted explicit instruction found.
GM-only approval dialogs, technical provenance statuses and standard DnD item descriptions are not treated as player puzzle instructions.
Foundry in-session Regionwright API caches previous module file imports; a coordinated reload is needed before new module-script prose reliably appears.
Script source integrity is GM-verified; actual non-GM clickthrough/visibility tests are separate and not claimed here.
Original First Chest (024) player dialog macro updated without changing numeral/digit-wheel calculation; the macro name and secret solution remain GM-only and unchanged.
